title: Random Cut Forests, Games and Diffusion over Approximately Nested Anisotropic Local Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2611.19548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Just as the data in a dynamic stream changes, questions asked of the stream also change in intent: what to hold constant, which counterfactuals to consider, and so forth. Energy-based learning has been celebrated for its uniform approach to losses and estimation, but interpretability remains challenging. Tree-based methods, on the other hand, offer high interpretability but often rely on bespoke, disjointed estimators. Neither paradigm readily supports changing questions on streaming data. In this paper we take a step towards combining energy, interpretability, and streaming.   Random cut forests retain an evolving geometry of the data. We study this geometry as the basis for diffusion dynamics, prediction, explanation, and games. We show that several existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on the trees. The induced affinity is realized exactly by a sparse electrical network on each tree, giving a single energy calculus,

translated_title: 随机切割森林、博弈与近似嵌套各向异性局部几何上的扩散
translated_abstract: 正如动态流中的数据会不断变化，对流数据提出的问题在意图上也会随之改变：哪些因素保持不变、考虑哪些反事实等等。基于能量的学习因其对损失和估计的统一处理方式而备受赞誉，但可解释性仍然是一个挑战。另一方面，基于树的方法具有高度可解释性，但往往依赖于定制的、彼此割裂的估计器。这两种范式都不能轻易支持对流数据上问题意图的变化。在本文中，我们朝着将能量、可解释性和流式处理三者相结合的方向迈出了一步。随机切割森林保留了数据不断演化的几何结构。我们研究这种几何结构，将其作为扩散动力学、预测、解释和博弈的基础。我们证明了几种现有的分数是树上随机游走的逃逸概率。所诱导的亲和度恰好由每棵树上的稀疏电气网络实现，从而提供了一个统一的能量演算。
tldr: 该论文证明随机切割森林的演化树几何可作为扩散、预测与博弈的统一基础——现有分数等价于树上随机游走的逃逸概率，且诱导的亲和度可由每棵树上的稀疏电网精确实现，从而将能量学习、可解释性与流式处理统一在单一的能量演算框架之下。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies energy-based learning, interpretability, and streaming by showing that the evolving tree geometry of Random Cut Forests underlies diffusion dynamics, prediction, and games, where existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on trees and the induced affinity is exactly realized by a sparse electrical network on each tree.
